goal_features.statement: The Urbana-Champaign MCS develops professional computing skills through 32 credits of advanced coursework.

directory_policies.notes.11: Professional degree structure: Urbana-Champaign MCS has 32 credits without a thesis, with a possible full-time pace of three semesters.

source_excerpt: 32 credit hours of coursework and no thesis
fact_summary: The Urbana-Champaign on-campus MCS is coursework-only. The site describes a possible full-time pace of three semesters and distinguishes this degree from the online and Chicago variants.
